latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly create and export short video clips using AI, optimized for social media creators.

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB), describe your desired edit, and receive 1080p MP4 clips.
- Automated cloud-based setup: connects to backend and handles authentication transparently with 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports voice/text instructions for highlight cuts, transitions, background music, and share-ready formats.
- In-app commands for uploads, exports, checking credits, session status, and more.
- Responsive error handling for file support, token/session issues, and rate limits.
- Designed for TikTok creators wanting fast edits without complex tools.
